text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Warisan) (No. 3) 2019.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai objek

warisan dalam Perisytiharan Objek Warisan (No. 2) 2015 [P.U. (B) 488/2015] yang

disiarkan dalam Warta pada 15 Disember 2015 dan disenaraikan dalam Daftar

diisytiharkan sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan.

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Malaysia

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the

National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of

National Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 3) Order 2019.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects

in the Declaration of Heritage Object (No. 2) 2015 [P.U. (B) 488/2015] as published in

the Gazette on 15 December 2015 and listed in the Register are declared to be

National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

(1)

Objects

(2)

Location of objects displayed

1. The gold coin in the reign of Sultan

Abdullah Maayat Shah (1615-1623),

Johore

Department of Museums Malaysia,

Kuala Lumpur

2. The official car of the Yang di-Pertuan

Agong I until the Yang di-Pertuan

Agong VI (Rolls Royce Silver Wraith)

Kelantan State Museum

Corporation

Dated 14 August 2019

[JWN.PUU.600-1/3/1; PN(PU2)652/XVII]

DATUK MOHAMADDIN BIN KETAPI

Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture Malaysia
